title: British Soldier Fusiler Lewis Arrested By Members Of The Japanese Naval Landing Party

page_data.en:
N.K.
FM.
G. 20M.

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.    File No.__________
S. 1. Special Branch Station,
REPORT
Date October 15, 1937.

Subject British Soldier Arrested By Members Of The Japanese Naval
Landing Party.

Made by D. S. Hamashita    Forwarded by C. Gimson

With reference to the attached translation from the
"Kodo" dated October 12, 1937, the following information
was obtained from Captain Ohtorii, in charge of the Japanese
Company, S.V.C.:-

At about 7.30 p.m., October 9, 1937, a foreign
soldier in uniform approached the Japanese position at
Range Road near North Szechuen Road coming from a westerly
direction, when he was arrested by members of the Japanese
Naval Landing Party occupying the post and immediately
escorted to the Japanese Gendarmerie.

Captain Ohtorii was called to the gendarmerie office
to assist in establishing the identity of the person and it
was later discovered that he was Fusilier Lewis attached to
the Royal Welch Fusiliers. Captain Ohtorii, then,
communicated with an officer of the unit and ascertained
that he had absconded from his unit. He was handed over
to an officer of the Royal Welch Fusiliers who visited the
Japanese Gendarmerie office.

（印：B 1037）    D. S. Hamashita
D. S.

（批：28/10）    （签名）

上海公共租界工部局警务处。    档案号___
S. 1. 特别股分站，
报告
日期：1937年10月15日。

事由：英国士兵被日本海军陆战队成员逮捕。

呈报人：D. S. Hamashita    转呈人：C. Gimson

关于随附的1937年10月12日《兴亚》（Kodo）报译文，从负责上海志愿连（S.V.C.）日军分队的大鸟（Ohtorii）上尉处获得如下信息：-

1937年10月9日晚7时30分左右，一名身着制服的外国士兵从西面方向接近北四川路附近的靶子路（Range Road）日军阵地，当时被驻守该哨位的日本海军陆战队成员逮捕，并立即押送至日本宪兵队。

大鸟上尉被召至宪兵队办公室协助确认该人身份，随后查明其为皇家威尔士燧发枪团（Royal Welch Fusiliers）所属的列兵刘易斯（Lewis）。大鸟上尉随即与该部队的一名军官取得联系，并证实该士兵已从其所部潜逃。随后，他被移交给前来日本宪兵队办公室的皇家威尔士燧发枪团的一名军官。

（印：B 1037）    D. S. Hamashita

October 12, 1937.

Jikyoku Godo

FOREIGN SOLDIER DESIRES TO JOIN JAPANESE ARMY

At about 8 p.m. on October 9, a Japanese force on Range Road arrested a foreign soldier who was later handed over to the Japanese Gendarmerie. When questioned by the Japanese military police, he stated that he arrived in Shanghai from Hongkong about six weeks ago. He belongs to C Infantry Regiment and gave the name of Huse Luiz (?), aged 26. He stated that he escaped from his barracks with a view to seeing the war zone and did not wish to return to his barracks and expressed his desire to join the Japanese forces.

After one night's detention at the gendarmerie the authorities referred the matter to the Commander Officer of a certain unit through Captain Ohtorii of the S.V.C. In compliance with the request of the commanding officer the Japanese military authorities handed the man over to the representative of the foreign force at the Garden Bridge.

S.I.

1937年10月12日。

时事联合（Jikyoku Godo）

外国士兵欲加入日军

10月9日晚8时许，一支日军部队在靶子路（Range Road）逮捕了一名外国士兵，该士兵随后被移交给日本宪兵队。在接受日本宪兵讯问时，他称自己约六周前从香港抵达上海。他隶属于C步兵团，自称胡塞·路易兹（Huse Luiz (?)），年龄26岁。他表示，为了观看战区情况而逃离军营，并不希望返回军营，且表达了加入日军部队的愿望。

在宪兵队拘留一晚后，当局通过上海志愿连（S.V.C.）的大鸟上尉将此事转告某部队指挥官。应指挥官的要求，日本军方将该人移交给外军代表，移交地点在外白渡桥。

S.I.
